recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Apply the article correction in the THO/terminology source for http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/gender-identity, then let downstream rendered FHIR and Extension Pack pages consume the corrected external terminology artifact.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core vocabulary technical correction requesting that the gender-identity ValueSet definition change from "Codes that indicate a individual's gender identity" to "Codes that indicate an individual's gender identity."
initial_application: Core commit 9fb5ed1a13c306ccffa5fd2436fabc00e64920fd applied the requested article correction in source/patient/valueset-gender-identity.xml. Later commit c81773b01523a9249faed5e940e63e9f3afa10d5, applying FHIR-39237 to the same definition, expanded the text and reintroduced "a individual's" before f3c0d3659cb93c99329c153a85820bb086df832f removed the value set from core.
additional_context: Current FHIR-core source has no gender-identity ValueSet source file or active source/fhir.ini ValueSet entry; git grep finds only the canonical OID mapping in source/oids.ini. The value set moved to the FHIR Extension Pack, was renamed there, and was later removed when terminology resources moved to THO. The current terminology.hl7.org JSON/XML for ValueSet-gender-identity still contains "Codes that indicate a individual's gender identity...".
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined FHIR branch and made no FHIR-core source change because the remaining authoritative correction belongs to the external THO/terminology source.

related_jiras.note: Expanded the same gender-identity ValueSet definition with minimum-set guidance and reintroduced the old article before the value set moved out of core.
